name: montage
description: Import Drive or Dropbox videos, create editable clips, and repurpose recorded knowledge through the Montage MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Ingest videos and cut them into shareable moments
interface.longDescription: Import a Google Drive or Dropbox recording into Montage, follow its processing outcome, create editable clips, or use transcripts and visual analysis for evidence-backed summaries, posts and research. Writing stays in the assistant unless you request a clip.
defaultPrompt: Ingest this video into Montage and tell me when it is ready.
Find the best 60 seconds of this video and make a moment from it.
Summarize this recording and cite the supporting timestamps.
